overview: This enum chooses what the game checks to decide whether a battle wave's goal is met.

None.technical: FGameDataTableRow_MissionOrder defaults OrderType to this value. The achievement switch has no case for it, so an order holding it leaves bAchieved false.

Normal.simple: A standard wave goal with no special completion check.
Normal.technical: No named consumer reads this member in the reconstructed source. The achievement switch reaches its default branch for it and leaves bAchieved false.

Boss.simple: The wave is a boss fight with its own announcement and cost display.
Boss.technical: The overlay selects StartMissionBossWaveWidget for the wave intro and title display. The player-info and radar widgets collect enemy MissionCharacter Cost values for boss waves, and the versus wave-info widget marks the wave as a boss order. These are UI branches, not an achievement check.

Protracted.simple: The wave is won by surviving for the listed time.
Protracted.technical: BattleStory_IsMissionOrderAchieved reads the round TimeLimit log value for Myself with PassiveType Send and sets bAchieved when that elapsed time in seconds is at least Value[0]. Result states compare raw byte 3 and suppress the remaining-time display when the player's team is the winner.

Event.simple: The wave is won when the rival team's average health gets low enough.
Event.technical: The achievement check reads HitPointRate from the rival team with PassiveType Send and sets bAchieved when the mean rate is at most Value[0]. Story enemy setup compares raw byte 4, and when Value[1] is positive it uses Value[0] as HitPointMinRate so each enemy gets HitPointMin of Value[0] times its MissionCharacter HitPoint. Story character select also replaces the order detail text with BTL_MISSION_ORDER_MESSAGE_0001 for this type.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack.simple: The wave is won by landing a super Cursed Energy attack.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack.technical: The achievement check reads SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Hit from the ally team with PassiveType Send and sets bAchieved when the count is at least 1.0.

SuperCursedEnergyAttackFinish.simple: The wave is won by finishing an enemy with a super Cursed Energy attack.
SuperCursedEnergyAttackFinish.technical: The achievement check reads SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Finish from the ally team and requires a count of at least 1.0. The failure check also requires enemy character stock index 1 to be at most zero and the same finish count to be at most zero.

DomainExpansion.simple: The wave ends when the player completes the Domain Expansion sequence.
DomainExpansion.technical: The cached mission order type is checked in the Domain Expansion free-state tick. When the caster's team is team A and the cached type is this value, the battle result becomes Win_TeamA, the result snapshot is built, and the state shuts down after the sequence finishes.

SpecialTagCombo.simple: The wave is won by landing a Special Tag Combo.
SpecialTagCombo.technical: The achievement check reads SpecialTagCombo_Hit from the ally team and requires a count of at least 1.0. The result wait state also forces Win_TeamA when performer 0 belongs to team A and the cached order type is this value.

Extra.simple: An extra wave goal with no special completion check in the reconstructed source.
Extra.technical: No named consumer reads this member. It falls through the achievement switch to the default branch, which leaves bAchieved false.

Invalid.simple: This value means no mission order is available.
Invalid.technical: FStudioBattleMissionTaskSystem::GetMissionOrderType returns this value when its cached MissionOrder pointer is null. AGameBattleManager forwards that cached value, so end-state checks for DomainExpansion and SpecialTagCombo do not match without an order.

notes: The achievement switch handles Protracted, Event, SuperCursedEnergyAttack, SuperCursedEnergyAttackFinish and SpecialTagCombo. Other values leave bAchieved false.
Two result-state functions compare raw byte 3 to hide remaining time after a player win.
Story enemy setup compares raw byte 4 and uses Value[1] as the gate for the Value[0] HitPointMin rate.
Boss is consumed by wave presentation and cost displays. The achievement switch has no case for it.
DomainExpansion and SpecialTagCombo are checked through the cached GetMissionOrderType value. That accessor returns Invalid when no order is cached.
None, Normal and Extra have no explicit named consumer in the reconstructed source. Normal and Extra occur in exported MissionOrderDataTable rows.
